name: Anthrocon
blurb: One of the world's largest furry conventions, held every summer at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh.

editions.evidence: Homepage title and text: 'Anthrocon 2027 - LEVEL 30: BEGIN July 1-4, 2027. We're excited to have you join for our 30th edition of Anthrocon, with details coming Fall 2026!'

notes: Homepage explicitly says full 2027 details (which would include any Guest of Honor program) are 'coming Fall 2026'; the site's only guest-of-honor news posts in its sitemap ('introducing-our-first-guest-of-honor', '...ursula-vernon') sit among 2017-2018 news items, so they are an old year's announcements, not 2027's -- guests is 'none-yet'. Venue confirmed via the hotel page's own text ('a few blocks from the David L. Lawrence Convention Center'); no venue name appears on the homepage itself. Batch note's '20,618 attendees in 2026 / second-largest furry convention' figure was not independently re-confirmed on the official site this pass (its attendance-graph page is JS-rendered and wasn't fetched), so that specific number is left out of the blurb per the no-unverified-attendance-numbers rule.
